resources.string: For everyday use with a moderate charge limit.
For a phone that spends many hours connected to a charger. Keeps the battery level lower; does not guarantee bypass.
For more battery available before going out. Allows a higher charge level.
All values are percentages of the battery level. Resume requires a connected charger and suitable temperature. ACC must be running to enforce these limits.
Pauses charging when the battery reaches this level.
After a pause, resumes when the battery falls to this level or below.
Shuts down the phone at this level or below if the battery is not charging. This does not just pause charging.
Charging stops at %1$d%% and resumes at %2$d%% or below.
∞ for Stop removes the stop limit based on battery percentage. ∞ for Resume allows charging to resume at any battery level.
Charge limits are disabled for this profile.
ACC uses a compatible device control to enable or pause charging. Leave this on Automatic unless you know which method your device needs.
